## What changes between the two methods

TurboQuant and KIVI both target KV cache memory, but they optimize for different points on the accuracy, complexity, and compression tradeoff curve. TurboQuant adds more math to reduce distortion; KIVI keeps the method simpler and more directly tied to 2-bit cache compression. [...] TurboQuant
